summary: Crow's nest on Three Prong Mountain from the 1930s; abandoned in the 1940s; firelookout.com says still there in the 1980s; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Last reported still there in the 1980s; no source says what stands today

visit.trail_note: Filed as a hike-in site by Idaho Fire Lookouts; no source describes the site today

events.note: Still there in the 1980s, per firelookout.com

corrections.why: Both lookout listings and the Idaho index say abandoned, and firelookout.com says it was still there in the 1980s. No source reports it gone, so an editor should confirm before the record changes.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and idahofirelookouts.com name the Nez Perce and Bitterroot forests together; weebly names only the Bitterroot. The story uses the two-forest wording.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two lookout listings, one weebly page and a state index. None describes the site after the 1980s. The weebly photos come from the Bitterroot archive with permission required, so none were added. The brief's gone status is not supported by any source read; the correction proposes abandoned for editor review.
